name: pickthetravel
description: Plan a whole trip in one sentence: nonstop flights, the trains and buses that run that day, plane against train door to door, the hotel with its live price. Save it to Pick the travel, which watches it for you.

interface.longDescription:
Pick the travel plans your whole trip from one sentence, then watches it for you.

Say it the way you would say it to a friend: "Paris to Zurich next Tuesday for 2 nights, nice hotel". Pick the travel answers live from its own family of travel sites:
• Who flies it nonstop: every airline on the route, to book direct (picktheflight.com). A place with no airport of its own flies via the nearest one, and says so.
• The trains and buses that run that day: every direct train and cross-border bus with its times, from the operators' published timetables (pickthetrain.com, pickthebus.com).
• Plane or train, door to door: the trip raced from city centre to city centre, airport and security included.
• Where to stay: one hotel for what you asked for (the finest, affordable luxury, best value, a bargain, or one room for a family), every hotel judged the same way with no paid placement, and for exact dates the live price of a refundable room (pickthehotel.com).
• What to sort before you go: travel insurance, and an eSIM when you leave the EU's roaming area.

Then save it. Saving gives a private link that opens the trip in Pick the travel, with no account. There you tick what is booked, switch to another train that day, and switch on reminders: a week before, the evening before, time to go with a leave-by time, on arrival and before the trip home, by phone notification or email. Pick the travel also re-reads the timetable of every saved train and bus and tells you if yours moves or stops running that day. Change the trip later from the chat or in the app: both see the same trip.

Nothing is invented: times, airlines and prices come from the family's own data, and a way that does not exist says why. Pick the travel does not sell tickets or take payments: you book with the airline, the rail or bus operator, or through Pick the hotel. Booking links may earn a commission, never at a cost to you.

positive.description: Plan a dated trip from one sentence
positive.prompt: Paris to Zurich next Tuesday for 2 nights, nice hotel
positive.expected_behavior: Shows plane against train door to door, the airlines flying it nonstop (Air France, Swiss International Air Lines), the direct trains that run that day with their times (TGV Lyria), the direct buses, and a Zurich hotel with its live refundable price for the 2 nights, in a trip card with a Save my trip button.

positive.description: A place with no airport of its own
positive.prompt: London to Gstaad in 3 weeks for 3 nights, luxury
positive.expected_behavior: Says Gstaad has no airport of its own and to fly into Geneva (GVA), 94 km away, lists the airlines flying London to Geneva nonstop, and picks the finest hotel in Gstaad (Gstaad Palace).

positive.prompt: Plan Vienna to Venice next Friday for 3 nights and save it
positive.expected_behavior: Plans the trip (the direct train that day, a Venice hotel with its live price), saves it and returns a private pickthetravel.com/t/ link; the card shows Saved and an Open in Pick the travel button.

positive.description: Change a saved trip from the chat
positive.prompt: Save a trip from Paris to Zurich next Tuesday for 2 nights, then make it 3 nights
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the trip, then changes that same trip to 3 nights: the return moves one day later with that day's train, the hotel price is for 3 nights, and the private link stays the same.

positive.description: Read back what is still to book
positive.prompt: Save a trip from Munich to Prague next Friday for 2 nights, then tell me what's still to book
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the way there, the hotel and the way back as still to book, plus travel insurance, and says reminders are switched on in Pick the travel.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Zurich tomorrow?

negative.description: Currency conversion is not trip planning

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn

publication.release_notes: The developer is now Goldcote Ltd, the company that makes Pick the travel. The app itself is unchanged.
